summary: 256-byte scene sprite and popup memory pool container allocated in Gfx_EntryPool_Init (0x002E5294) via Mem_AllocAligned_2(0x100), initialized by Battle_PopupPool_InitEntry (0x0058E264), and managed by Gfx_Scene_Release (0x0058F054) / Gfx_Scene_ResetPools (0x0058E2E4); embeds a 32-byte draw packet (0x0C), 5 parallel entry pools with bitmaps (0x2C), a sub-buffer (0x94), and a 92-byte Gfx_SpritePool (0xA4).
evidence: Allocated 0x100 (256) bytes in Gfx_EntryPool_Init (0x002E5294) with vtable 0x00782B54; initialized in Battle_PopupPool_InitEntry (0x0058E264) which configures drawPacket (0x0C), calls Battle_PopupPool_AllocateArrays (0x0058F304) for five entry pools at 0x2C..0x94 and sub-buffer at 0x94..0xA4, and constructs embedded Gfx_SpritePool (0x0058B86C) at 0xA4..0x100; destroyed by Gfx_Scene_Release (0x0058F054) and reset by Gfx_Scene_ResetPools (0x0058E2E4).
